detail.longDescription: Missed the Cloud-Native Geospatial Forum 2026, or couldn't catch every session? The recordings are now on YouTube. I reviewed the sessions and pulled together the talks that stood out most. My biggest takeaway: cloud-native geospatial is no longer a niche. It's becoming a key part of how AI systems discover, access, and reason about spatial data. Highlights, notes, and playlist links: https:// davidgsmith.net/thoughts/cng-f orum-2026-sessions-posted-to-youtube.html?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social_share&utm_campaign=thoughts # geospatial # geoai # gis # opensource # cloudnative
